rationale: C24 plausibly supplied a concrete template for the child's central operative request. Both directives address Executive Branch cooperation with a Senate investigation, express the President's desire to cooperate to the greatest/fullest possible extent, and immediately qualify that cooperation by competing executive responsibilities or limitations. This combination of closely shared language, institutional setting, and qualified-cooperation structure is materially more distinctive than the generic interagency cooperation clauses in C01 or the confidentiality machinery in C17.

shared_material.child_excerpt: It is my desire that the Executive branch of the Government cooperate with the Committee to the fullest possible extent.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It is my desire, however, that the charges of disloyalty made before your Subcommittee be given the most thorough and complete investigation, and it is my purpose to cooperate with your Subcommittee to the greatest extent possible
shared_material.explanation: Both use a presidential statement of desire or purpose directing maximum Executive Branch cooperation with a Senate investigative committee.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the fullest cooperation and assistance consistent with the orderly performance of the work and duties of the departments and agencies and subject only to jurisdictional and appropriation limitations
shared_material.parent_excerpt: bearing in mind at all times my responsibility to take care that the investigative activities and efficiency of the Federal Bureau of Investigation and other investigative agencies remain unimpaired, that innocent people ... not be unnecessarily injured, and that the effectiveness of the employee loyalty program as a whole not be interfered with
shared_material.explanation: Each qualifies maximum cooperation by preserving Executive Branch operations, responsibilities, and institutional constraints.
